g.text: influx. L57: cluster-IV binding and brain

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243649
font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f6f7d

g.text: Provisional design targets only: PROCR and TM4SF1. SELP, ECSCR and ACKR1 remain documented alternatives; LRP1 is a separate benchmark.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f6f7d

g.text: ECD = extracellular domain; EC = endothelial cell; CPM = counts per million; LOSO = leave-one-sample-out direction stability.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f6f7d

g.text: Human brain atlas CPM and peripheral HPA nTPM use different datasets/scales and must NOT be interpreted as a selectivity ratio.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f6f7d

g.text: Published binding or uptake does not prove intact engineered peptide delivery; native luminal access, safety and epitope approval remain open.
